agent.sub: Set who your agent is. Everything here changes what your leads hear on the next call.
agent.unconfigured: Your agent has no identity of its own yet
agent.unconfiguredNote: Until you set a name and company here, it introduces itself to your leads as ClickScales' own agent. Set it before your next call.
agent.name: Agent name
agent.nameHint: Leads hear this name. It is spoken in Hebrew, so write it in Hebrew.
agent.nameRequired: Your agent needs a name — leads hear it in the first sentence.
agent.genderHint: Hebrew inflects the speaker's gender into almost every sentence. This sets it everywhere at once, including the greeting.
agent.companyHint: Who the agent says it works for.
agent.companyDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. a family-run garage in Haifa
agent.companyDescriptionHint: One short phrase. It follows the company name when the agent introduces itself.
agent.handoffHint: Named to the lead when booking. Leave blank and the agent offers the meeting without naming anyone.
agent.customGreetingHint: Optional. Leave blank and it is built from the name, company and gender above — which stays correct if you rename the agent later.
agent.voiceManaged: Chosen by ClickScales. Ask us to change it — a wrong voice id silences the call rather than failing, so it is not editable here.
agent.faqHint: Questions your leads actually ask, and exactly how the agent should answer. It reads these verbatim, so write the answer in Hebrew, as speech.
agent.faqEmpty: No answers yet. Without these, the agent says it will have the team get back to them.
agent.saveNote: Changes apply to the next call.
agent.savedNote: The next call uses the new identity.

members.sub: Everyone who can sign in to this workspace. Invite the people who work your leads — they each get their own login.

roleHints.admin: Can do everything except transfer ownership, including inviting and removing people.
roleHints.member: Can work leads, calls and the calendar, and change the agent. Cannot manage the team.
roleHints.viewer: Can look at everything and change nothing.
